strategy.human_thesis: Use only historically replayable OHLCV-derived evidence: a confirmed 20-bar breakout, evidence that the prior bar was compressed relative to its recent volatility baseline, then at least one secondary confirmation from volume expansion, candle close strength, or non-opposing higher-timeframe context.
strategy.expected_outcome: A simple control strategy for testing whether compression-to-breakout behavior has positive net expectancy after realistic execution friction. It is not a production trading strategy and should not be promoted from one backtest window.
strategy.indicator_description: OHLCV-only compression/breakout benchmark using breakout_above_n_bar_high or breakout_below_n_bar_low, compression_before_breakout, volume_ratio, breakout_close_strength, and htf_alignment. Weighting makes both breakout and compression mandatory for an actionable score.
strategy.notes: V28.12 research benchmark only. Uses OHLCV-derived features and HTF OHLCV context only. The 72-point threshold with 35 breakout points and 30 compression points makes both primary conditions mandatory; at least one secondary confirmation is also required. No funding, open interest, order-book, liquidation, or LLM input. Keep out of live/paper slots unless separately validated and explicitly promoted.
